messages:
camille: CI red on main, test timeout in runtime::serve::retry::test_deadline_noise
camille: https://ci.internal.redwood/intern/12345 - failure on linux-x86-64, non-deterministic
deploy-bot: build #12345 re-run requested by camille
bryan: can you paste the failing stack/log? quick grep for "deadline exceeded"
camille: ```
runtime::serve::retry::test_deadline_noise ... FAILED
thread 'tokio-runtime-worker' panicked at 'assertion failed: !timed_out', tests/retry.rs:142:13
Caused by: DeadlineExceededError { duration: 200ms }
``` 
alice: hm looks seed/clock sensitive. We added jitter recently in RetryManager. Could be scheduling slip under 200ms
jordana: can someone run `./scripts/ci_rerun.sh --build 12345 --smoke`? want a quick rerun to see frequency
michael: I'll run a local matrix on my macbook and a linux builder. doing `RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo test --test retry -- --nocapture test_deadline_noise --exact` and a 100-loop shell wrapper
camille: thx mike. also attaching the failing test harness lines: `sleep` replaced by `tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(n))` - might be clashing with mocked clock
bryan: if it's mock clock vs real clock, try enabling `--features clock-sim` or run in debug with env `USE_SIM_CLOCK=1` to see
alice: alternative quick fix: bump deadline in test to 400ms and mark flaky with TODO ticket, but I'd prefer a repro that reproduces locally
jordana: if mike reproduces, pls run `git bisect start` between the last known good (commit abcdef) and head - might narrow it to the jitter change
michael: local run: non-deterministic failure after ~37 loops on linux container. collecting `perf`/`strace` dump and pushing to gist
michael: https://gist.github.com/mike/6b7f... contains trace + core excerpt
camille: ok opening ticket INF-3812, will add steps, assign to @alice for hypothesis test + a small PR to add deterministic clock injection to that harness
bryan: cc @eng-sre in ticket for flaky test tracking
alice: I'll start a branch to add `SimulatedClock` to retry tests and add a smoke that runs in CI-only with `USE_SIM_CLOCK=1` env
camille: thanks all — leaving this open, will post updates here once CI rerun numbers come back :thumbsup:
